game.name: Fallout New Vegas (Austria, Switzerland)
game.desc: Welcome to Vegas. New Vegas. It's the kind of place where you'll dig your own grave before you get your head bashed in. It's a city where desperados fight each other for control of rare oases. The kind of place where the right person with the right equipment can make all the difference... and a lot of enemies. From the Mojave desert to the Vegas strip, via the Hoover Dam, you'll meet a host of endearing and colourful characters. Make the right alliances and choose your side to become the master of Vegas. The game offers great freedom to evolve and interact with the universe, from 'persuading' others (in every sense of the word) to massively destroying your enemies by satellite.
